source: MAFF Department of Agricultural Extension / ASPIRE Project, IFAD-funded - "បច្ចេកទេសដាំដុះក្រូចពោធិ៍សាត់ដែលធន់ទៅនឹងការប្រែប្រួលអាកាសធាតុ / Climate Resilient Orange Growing Technique", Nov 2018, 23pp
text:
Planting holes are dug roughly 1 cubic meter in size (ការរៀបចំរណ្តៅ), with compost or well-rotted manure mixed into the backfill soil to give the young tree a strong start. Seedlings are typically transplanted 20-30 days after they show healthy new growth in the nursery.

When transplanting (ការដាំ), the tree is set at the same depth it was growing in its nursery container, the hole is backfilled and the soil gently firmed - without compacting it too hard - and the tree is watered immediately after planting to settle the soil around the roots.
